research.title: Calibration Assessment for Binary Classifiers
bullets: Implemented assigned routines for grouping predicted probabilities into bins and computing calibration summaries using NumPy.
Ran prescribed logistic regression experiments on tabular data, checking probability outputs and documenting discrepancies between calibration plots and aggregate metrics.

work.title: Inventory and Order Records Support
bullets: Updated inventory records from receiving paperwork, checked item descriptions against delivery documents, and flagged discrepancies for supervisor review.
Prepared order packets, maintained filing records, and coordinated routine status updates with staff handling incoming deliveries and outgoing orders.

projects.title: Regularized Logistic Regression for Tabular Classification
bullets: Implemented a scikit-learn baseline with missing value imputation, feature standardization, and regularized logistic regression for a tabular classification task.
Compared regularization settings through cross-validation on training data and summarized held-out predictions using confusion matrices and probability-based evaluation metrics.
